fields.description: Which way the money moved for THIS box. `In` raises the box's cash; `Out` lowers it. A transfer is an entry with `other_box` set, and it takes this box's direction.
fields.label: Direction
Currency
fields.description: The currency this entry is in. It is REQUIRED, because a row that names no currency is silent rather than wrong - and a silent row is how a EUR entry lands in a USD balance with nothing to notice it (ADR-170). A row in a DIFFERENT currency is refused by the rollup, not converted.

What KIND of fact this entry records. `Invoice Issued` is an obligation the company has created but not yet settled; the other values are movements. A new kind of business fact is a new option here — it does not need a code change.

fields.description: BETWEEN whom the money moved. This is the axis that says who is on the other end, and it is deliberately separate from the category: a service payment and a vendor payment are different categories that can share a money flow.
fields.label: Money Flow

fields.description: `Cancelled` means the entry did not happen at all, and it is counted as nothing. `Pending` means the money has NOT moved yet — the entry is an obligation, and it is counted as owed rather than as received or distributed. `Completed` and `Settled` mean the money moved. `Reversed` means the money moved AND was undone by a compensating leg: the row still counts, and the leg is what takes the count back out. A row whose money moved may not be cancelled — it may be reversed (ADR-177).
fields.label: Status
Funding Source
fields.options:
Company Cash
Personal Cash
Loan
Other

fields.description: Set only on a TRANSFER: the other box the custody moved to or from. A transfer is an entry with a counterparty that is a box.
fields.label: Other Box

fields.description: Set only on a REVERSAL: the name of the entry this row undoes. A reversal is a compensating leg — the same amount, the opposite direction — and this field is what makes the pair traceable: it says which movement the leg belongs to. It is written by the reversal path, together with that path's leg, and it is never set by hand (ADR-177).
fields.label: Reversal Of
